title: The Widest Generation
statement:
A binary tree has `n` nodes numbered `1..n`, and node `1` is the root. For every node you are given its left child and right child, where `0` means there is no such child. The nodes at the same distance from the root form one generation. Find the largest number of nodes in a single generation.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The next `n` lines give the left and right child of node `1`, node `2`, ..., node `n`.

## Output
Print the size of the largest generation.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 12000`
- The input is a valid binary tree rooted at node `1`.
